logline: 제네바의 소년 빅터가 번개에 쪼개진 떡갈나무를 보고, 어머니를 여읜 뒤 잉골슈타트 대학에서 생명의 비밀을 찾겠다고 마음먹어 다락방에서 거대한 형체를 만들어 폭풍우의 밤에 살려 내고, 그것이 일어나 앉자 달아나 마당에서 밤을 새우고 친구 헨리의 간호를 받은 뒤 다시 오른 다락의 실험대가 텅 비어 있다
setting: 1790년대 제네바의 호숫가 집과 교회 묘지, 잉골슈타트의 대학 강의실과 하숙집 다락방, 밤의 묘지, 하숙집 마당과 침실
anchor: a pale young student of the 1790s in a dark blue coat in a garret laboratory with a brass electrical machine and a long table
palette: dark green, ash grey, off-white, dull yellow, dark brown
withheld: 피조물이 앗아 간 이들과, 북쪽 얼음 위의 추격

beats.beat: 어머니를 여읜 뒤 빅터는 잉골슈타트 대학으로 떠난다

beats.beat: 대학의 화학 강의에서 빅터는 생명의 비밀을 찾겠다고 마음먹는다
beats.visual: cool grey daylight through the tall windows of the high lecture room: the old man of sixty in the black scholar's gown and the short white wig, with the small round spectacles on his kind lined face, is the one standing at frame left behind the lectern with one hand raised and a small glass vessel held up in it to the light, his mouth open in speech; the long demonstration table before him holds more glass vessels in a row; the tiered wooden benches rise in rows at frame right and frame centre, and the young man of twenty with the dark brown hair tied back and the pale thin face, in the dark blue coat, is the one sitting on the second bench at frame centre leaning far forward with both his forearms on the desk before him and his dark eyes fixed on the raised glass vessel, his lips pressed together; the other benches around him are empty of people; the tall windows behind the lectern show the flat grey sky; there are exactly two people in the room and the young man on the bench is the one leaning forward

beats.beat: 빅터는 밤마다 다락방에 올라가 홀로 등불을 켠다
beats.visual: deep night in the garret room at the top of the tall house with its sloping ceiling and bare rafters: the young man of twenty with the dark brown hair tied back and the pale thin face with the hollow cheeks, in the dark blue coat with the white neckcloth loosened, is the one standing at frame centre beneath the lamp that hangs from a rafter, reaching up with a lit taper in one hand to the lamp's open glass so that the small dull yellow flame inside is just taking, his face lifted to it and lit from beneath, his other hand holding the lamp steady by its ring; the long wooden table runs down the middle of the room behind him, bare except for a few glass jars at its far end; the shelves of glass jars stand along the wall at frame left with their contents dark; the one dormer window at frame right is black; the rest of the room is in shadow; there is exactly one person in the room

beats.beat: 묘지와 도살장을 돌며 빅터가 필요한 것을 하나씩 그러모은다
beats.visual: deep night in the town graveyard with a low mist lying over the ground, the thin moon behind thin cloud: the young man of twenty with the dark brown hair tied back and the pale thin face, in the dark blue coat with the collar turned up, is the one walking away from the camera down the path between the rows of leaning gravestones at frame centre, seen from behind with his face hidden, a heavy shapeless sack slung over one shoulder and a spade in his other hand, his figure bent a little under the weight; the leaning gravestones stand in their rows on both sides of the path with their carved faces turned away from the path, plain grey backs to the camera; the bare tree stands black at frame left; the open iron gate shows small at the far end of the path ahead of him; the mist lies ash grey over the long grass to the height of the gravestones' feet; there is exactly one person in the graveyard and his back is to the camera

beats.beat: 다락의 긴 실험대 위에 거대한 형체가 천에 덮인 채 눕혀진다

beats.beat: 폭풍우 치던 밤, 빅터가 마지막 놋 손잡이를 힘껏 당겨 내린다
beats.visual: the night of the storm in the garret, the dormer window at frame right a plain pale glare with heavy rain streaking down its glass: the tall brass electrical machine with the big glass disc is the one thing at frame left with its copper coils and its wires, and the wooden board of brass levers stands beside it; the young man of twenty with the dark brown hair coming loose from its ribbon and the pale thin face with the hollow cheeks, in his white shirt with the sleeves rolled, is the one standing at frame centre with both his hands gripping the last brass lever, the longest on the board, pulled down almost to the bottom of its slot, his whole weight leaned on it and his face turned over his shoulder toward the table with his eyes wide; the long bundle wrapped in grey sheeting and bound with three cords lies on the long table behind him running to the right edge of the frame, the wires from the machine running in under its sheeting; the hanging lamp swings a little on its rafter; there is exactly one person in the room

beats.visual: the night of the storm in the garret, close on the near end of the long wooden table under the dull yellow light of the hanging lamp: the edge of the plain grey sheet is the one thing filling the upper part of the frame, and from under its edge at frame centre a single huge hand hangs over the table's edge, the hand of a giant, its skin a dull yellowish grey stretched tight over the long bones, the black nails long and square, the wrist under the sheet's edge as thick as a man's forearm, the fingers hanging loose and still; the rough grain of the table's edge runs along the bottom of the frame with a thick wire lying along it; the pale glare of the window shows at the far right with the rain streaking down the glass; the rest of the shape under the sheet runs away to the left out of the frame; there is no face in the picture and no other person; the hand is the only part of the shape that shows

beats.beat: 천을 밀치고 실험대 위에서 천천히 일어나 앉는 거대한 형체
beats.visual: the night of the storm in the garret, seen from the foot of the long wooden table: the huge figure eight feet tall is the one thing sitting up on the table at frame centre with its back to the camera and its face wholly hidden, the long lank black hair hanging to its shoulders, the yellowish grey skin stretched tight over the very broad shoulders and the long back, the plain grey sheet fallen round its waist and lying over its legs on the table, one huge hand flat on the table at each side of it with the black nails spread; the tall brass electrical machine with the big glass disc stands beyond it at the head of the table at frame left with its wires now hanging slack to the floor; the hanging lamp gives its dull yellow light from above; the dormer window at frame right is a pale glare streaked with rain; the shelves of glass jars stand along the wall in shadow; there is exactly one figure in the room and its back is to the camera, and no face is seen

beats.beat: 그 형체를 보자마자 빅터는 뒤도 돌아보지 않고 다락방을 뛰쳐나간다
beats.visual: the night of the storm on the narrow wooden stair leading down from the garret, seen from the top of the stair looking down: the young man of twenty with the dark brown hair fallen loose from its ribbon and the pale thin face, in his white shirt with the sleeves rolled, is the one going down the stair at frame centre seen entirely from behind and above, only the back of his head with its loose dark hair, the back of his white shirt and the heels of his shoes showing, his face turned fully away toward the landing below and hidden, three steps down already, one hand flung out against the wall and the other gripping the wooden rail, his shirt pulled sideways at the shoulder; the stair drops steeply between two bare plaster walls to a small landing below where a door stands ajar with a thin grey light in its gap; the dull yellow light of the garret lamp comes from behind the camera down the top steps; the bare treads of the stair are worn pale in the middle; there is exactly one person on the stair and his back is to the camera

beats.beat: 비 내리는 새벽 마당에서 빅터가 밤새 떨고 있다
beats.visual: grey dawn in the paved courtyard of the tall lodging house with the rain still coming down: the young man of twenty with the dark brown hair hanging loose and wet and the pale thin face with the hollow cheeks, in his white shirt soaked through and clinging to his shoulders, is the one sitting at frame centre on the wooden bench against the wall with his back bent and both his arms wrapped round himself, his knees drawn up and his bare feet on the wet paving stones, his face turned down and half hidden by his wet hair; the iron pump stands at frame left with rainwater running from its spout; rainwater stands between the paving stones and the rain makes small rings in it; the stone arch to the street shows at frame right with the grey light of the dawn in it; the tall wall of the house rises behind the bench with one small window high up, dark; there is exactly one person in the courtyard

beats.beat: 고향 친구 헨리가 마차에서 내려 빅터를 부른다

beats.beat: 열병으로 쓰러진 빅터를 헨리가 여러 달 곁에서 돌본다

beats.beat: 빅터가 다시 오른 다락의 실험대는 텅 비어 있다

beats.beat: 빈 다락의 열린 창으로 바람이 든다
beats.visual: thin grey daylight in the garret room: the one dormer window is the one thing at frame centre, standing wide open on its hinge with the flat grey sky in it and the wet slates of the roof outside showing below the sill; across the pale floorboards from the one long wooden table to the window runs a trail of huge muddy footprints, each footprint the long narrow shape of a human sole with a rounded heel and toe marks, far bigger than any ordinary footprint, spaced a long stride apart, the last footprint lying on the sill itself at the open window; the one long wooden table shows bare at the bottom left of the frame with its dust, the only table in the room; the sloping rafters come down close over the window; a few glass jars stand on the shelf at frame right; the plain grey sheet lies crumpled on the floor at the far left; the still room holds only the one table, the sheet, the jars and the footprints, and the window stands open to the grey sky
